newsitem.title: USA: Oil prices of great interest to Fed - McDonough.
newsitem.headline: Oil prices of great interest to Fed - McDonough.

text.p: Federal Reserve Bank of New York President William McDonough said that while the Fed uses core inflation as its main guide in the battle against inflation, energy prices and particularly oil prices are also of great interest.

"We tend, when we look at price stability, to look at core inflation which leaves out food and energy prices because they are so variable," said McDonough, responding to questions after a speech to the New York City Partnership.
"You have a cold snap and heating oil prices go up and then the weather gets warmer and the prices go down," he added.

"(But) one cannot overlook completely energy prices because if they go up and stay up then they start getting into other prices," he said, noting that oil prices are a matter of "great interest" and "concern" to the Fed.
